column3: Abstract is 150-250 words AND <=1920 characters -- arXiv's hard metadata ceiling (info.arxiv.org/help/prep.html, re-verified 2026-08-16). Counted on the DECODED string: wc -w and awk NF disagree across platforms on this text

column3: Author block carries the name, *Independent researcher* and an email

column3: Keywords line carries 6-8 keywords
column4: cmd:cd $HOME/repos/wealth-tensor && grep -A1 '^\*\*Keywords:\*\*' docs/papers/paper-III-dual-tensor/paper-III.md | tr '\n' ' ' | tr '·' '\n' | grep -c '[a-z]' | awk '{exit !($1>=6 && $1<=8)}'

column3: JEL classification codes present

column3: Explicit numbered contributions list in the introduction

column3: Abandoned approaches is a BODY section, not an appendix (ADR-001: load-bearing in every paper)

column3: Data and code availability names the repo URL, module paths, a regeneration command and the test command
column4: cmd:cd $HOME/repos/wealth-tensor && awk '/^## 11 · Data and code availability/{f=1;next} /^# /{if(f)f=0} f' docs/papers/paper-III-dual-tensor/paper-III.md > /tmp/s11.txt && grep -q 'github.com/jasoncbraatz/wealth-tensor' /tmp/s11.txt && grep -q 'src/wealth_tensor/' /tmp/s11.txt && grep -q 'python3 scripts/' /tmp/s11.txt && grep -q 'pytest' /tmp/s11.txt

column3: No live placeholders. The existence leg is FIRST on purpose: an absence predicate passes vacuously on a missing file (-49's rule), proved red in-session
